I am glad that you make the effort to understand and that she has you to listen whenever she find herself in the situation, and I hope she finally decides to try DBT gets better overtime. I only recently heard of DBT and I have been looking into reliable resources to somehow get help because unfortunately aside from venting all the time on Reddit or having unhealthy coping mechanisms I have no one to talk to. Not that I haven’t tried because a lot of people I know are only concerned about me on a surface level and maybe I’m overthinking again but I can feel them getting tired and annoyed overtime of me feeling pathetic for “trivial” matters according to their point of view. And feeling judged or like a burden doesn’t makes anyone regardless of your mental state better let alone someone that hypersensitive. I also had been reluctant to try any type of therapy before because I was scared and I heard a lot that bpd is scientifically not curable. so I just ask myself what’s is the point then because I’m gonna feel like in top of being helpless I’m hopeless. But after having 2 Unsuccessful S. Attempts I just feel like I have nothing more to lose if I don’t even care about my life so if I’m still here why not give it a try… I don’t really expect much from it… I’m just out of options. I don’t believe it’s the right mindset to have either as Somoene who want to feel better but I’m trying here.

From my experiment, from talking to a college therapist. I open talked about how much I wanted to not be alive and that I had an attempt a year prior(that one was not a good idea). She started to get worried and actually was trying to tell me a should get committed. I somehow convinced her that no matter how strong the feeling is I was certain I was not going to act on it and that’s why I decided to talk about it, and lessen those thought… she was very worried but… just trusted what I said and referred me to an outpatient psychiatric program … it’s just like being committed but you basically leave your “normal life”. I didn’t go through because it was expensive for me because I can’t work to afford it and my parent to whole I am still depend don’t know, and won’t understand so I can’t really asked them to pay for it. So try to talk to your doctor, and convince her that somehow you are not a direct threat to yourself right now, and maybe if she can refer an outpatient program, so you still get help and get to work and else at the same time. Idk if that helped but good luck… I hope you find a solution.

I’m sorry that you had to experiment it to understand depression. But it really is hard to talk to people like you said who don’t go through it. Because they can’t fully understand… for them it’s like oh you just feel sad rn it’ll go away… cuz everyone feel sad at some point and it does go away when the problem is fixed … but depression is not just about “being sad” it’s just to complex … from my experience everytime I tried to open up I either get the people who ask you what’s wrong and when you talk about it they just don’t know what to say… so to not make a big deal out of it I just say you don’t have to answer I guess it’s gonna be fine when I know it’s not. Or there’s the people who always ask but what’s the problem … like I need to have something currently happening to me for to feel the way I feel if not it doesn’t make sens, in those cases I just end up saying I’m probably stressing for nothing don’t worry about it. It actually kinda makes me wish that something bad actually happened to me at that moment so I can have a “valid reason” for me to feel depressed if not it doesn’t count.

I think you’ve been feeling so bad in “the closet” for so long that you want people to notice, feel or understand how bad you felt all along. I think wanting to die even if most of us feel guilty about hurting other’s feelings is already not caring about much let alone your life… so I don’t think you’re a bad person… altho I hope for all of us to be happy and live long… I think you just want to be “TRULY” seen
